This file consolidates the normative, clinical, cross-sample, validity, IRT, DIF, retest, cross-informant, and norming analyses for the youth NQLS. Analytic choices follow the 5040 Standardized Psychometric Protocol. Where the source files differ, the verified `NQLS_youth_protocol_v1.qmd` implementation is used.

# 1 Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", "haven", "readxl", "lubridate", "psych", "nFactors",
  "lavaan", "semTools", "mirt", "lordif", "cocor", "gamlss"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop("Install the following packages before running this file: ",
       paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(psych)
library(nFactors)
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(mirt)
library(lordif)
library(cocor)
library(gamlss)

select <- dplyr::select
set.seed(2112)

# Update only these paths when the data move/change. The verified combined file is preferred; the original 1,008-youth file remains a fallback.
normative_file <- read_sav("scored_child_12_18_1008dyads_9.1.26.sav")
parent_file <- read_sav("scored_parent_12_18_alldyad_N1008_9.1.26.sav")
clinical_file  <- read_xlsx("V2_NQLS_Baseline_Clinical.xlsx")

ord_items_y <- paste0("nqlsy0", 1:7)
general_items_y <- c("nqlsy01", "nqlsy02", "nqlsy05", "nqlsy06", "nqlsy07")
school_items_y  <- c("nqlsy03", "nqlsy04")
nqls_subscales_y <- list(General = general_items_y, School = school_items_y)
nqls_full_y <- list(Total = ord_items_y, General = general_items_y, School = school_items_y)

clinical_items <- c(
  "NQLS_Friends", "NQLS_Family", "NQLS_Grades", "NQLS_School",
  "NQLS_Health", "NQLS_Life", "NQLS_Future"
)

norm_to_clinical <- c(
  nqlsy01 = "NQLS_Friends", nqlsy02 = "NQLS_Family",
  nqlsy03 = "NQLS_Grades",  nqlsy04 = "NQLS_School",
  nqlsy05 = "NQLS_Health",  nqlsy06 = "NQLS_Life",
  nqlsy07 = "NQLS_Future"
)

# Verified partial-scalar solution from the clinical comparison notebook.
# Recheck lavTestScore() whenever the clinical dataset changes.
thresholds_to_free <- c("NQLS_Life|t3")

prorated_sum <- function(data, items, min_answered) {
  n_answered <- rowSums(!is.na(data[items]))
  ifelse(n_answered >= min_answered,
         rowMeans(data[items], na.rm = TRUE) * length(items), NA_real_)
}

fit_values <- function(fit) {
  requested <- c(
    "chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled", "cfi.scaled", "tli.scaled",
    "rmsea.scaled", "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr"
  )
  available <- intersect(requested, names(lavaan::fitMeasures(fit)))
  out <- unclass(lavaan::fitMeasures(fit, available))
  setNames(out, sub("\\.scaled$", "", names(out)))
}
```

```{r normative-data}
fulldata <- normative_file
df_raw <- fulldata
df <- haven::zap_labels(df_raw)

stopifnot(all(ord_items_y %in% names(df)))

# Codes 8 and 9 are labelled skipped/not asked and must not enter scoring.
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(ord_items_y), ~ replace(as.numeric(.x), .x %in% c(8, 9), NA_real_)))

item_labels_y <- vapply(ord_items_y, function(x) {
  label <- attr(df_raw[[x]], "label")
  if (is.null(label)) x else as.character(label)
}, character(1))

range_check_y <- map_dfr(ord_items_y, ~ tibble(
  item = .x,
  minimum = min(df[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE),
  maximum = max(df[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE),
  n_missing = sum(is.na(df[[.x]]))
))
range_check_y
stopifnot(all(range_check_y$minimum >= 0), all(range_check_y$maximum <= 4))

has_nqlsy_complete <- complete.cases(df[ord_items_y])
nqlsGoodItems <- df[has_nqlsy_complete, ord_items_y]

nqlsGoodSchoolItems <- nqlsGoodItems %>% 
  select(all_of(school_items_y))
nqlsGoodGeneralItems <- nqlsGoodItems %>% 
  select(all_of(general_items_y))

age_source_y <- if ("actual_age.youth" %in% names(df)) {
  "actual_age.youth"
} else if ("actual_age" %in% names(df)) {
  "actual_age"
} else {
  "age_child"
}

# Preserve the variable names used in the original normative file.
youth_nqls <- df %>%
  transmute(
    caseid,
    age_child = as.numeric(.data[[age_source_y]]),
    across(any_of(c("sex_child", "sex_select", names(df)[startsWith(names(df), "race_")]))),
    across(all_of(ord_items_y)),
    nqlsytot = prorated_sum(cur_data(), ord_items_y, min_answered = 6),
    nqlsysubscalelife = prorated_sum(cur_data(), general_items_y, min_answered = 4),
    nqlsysubscaleschool = ifelse(
      complete.cases(cur_data()[school_items_y]),
      rowSums(cur_data()[school_items_y]), NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("race_"), ~ ifelse(.x == 2, 0, .x)))

# Verify the supplied total rather than assuming it is correct.
fresh_total_y <- rowSums(df[ord_items_y])
if ("nqlsytot" %in% names(df)) {
  total_check_y <- tibble(
    n_compared = sum(!is.na(df$nqlsytot) & has_nqlsy_complete),
    mean_abs_difference = mean(
      abs(df$nqlsytot[has_nqlsy_complete] - fresh_total_y[has_nqlsy_complete]),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    max_abs_difference = max(
      abs(df$nqlsytot[has_nqlsy_complete] - fresh_total_y[has_nqlsy_complete]),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
  total_check_y
}
```

# 4 Validity analyses

```{r validity-data}
internal_items_y  <- c("pscy02", "pscy06", "pscy09", "pscy11", "pscy15")
attention_items_y <- c("pscy01", "pscy03", "pscy07", "pscy13", "pscy17")
external_items_y  <- c("pscy04", "pscy05", "pscy08", "pscy10", "pscy12", "pscy14", "pscy16")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pscy_int = prorated_sum(cur_data(), internal_items_y, 5),
    pscy_att = prorated_sum(cur_data(), attention_items_y, 5),
    pscy_ext = prorated_sum(cur_data(), external_items_y, 7),
    chrtysttot = if (all(paste0("chrty", sprintf("%02d", 1:9)) %in% names(df)))
      rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("chrty", sprintf("%02d", 1:9)))), na.rm = FALSE) else NA_real_,
    chrtyprtot = if (all(paste0("chrty", sprintf("%02d", 10:12)) %in% names(df)))
      rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("chrty", sprintf("%02d", 10:12)))), na.rm = FALSE) else NA_real_,
    vasyiatot = if (all(paste0("vasy", sprintf("%02d", 1:9)) %in% names(df)))
      rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("vasy", sprintf("%02d", 1:9)))), na.rm = FALSE) else NA_real_,
    vasyhitot = if (all(paste0("vasy", sprintf("%02d", 10:18)) %in% names(df)))
      rowSums(across(all_of(paste0("vasy", sprintf("%02d", 10:18)))), na.rm = FALSE) else NA_real_
  )

nqls_validity <- df %>%
  mutate(
    nqlsytot = ifelse(has_nqlsy_complete, rowSums(across(all_of(ord_items_y))), NA_real_),
    nqlsysubscalelife = ifelse(
      complete.cases(cur_data()[general_items_y]), rowSums(across(all_of(general_items_y))), NA_real_
    ),
    nqlsysubscaleschool = ifelse(
      complete.cases(cur_data()[school_items_y]), rowSums(across(all_of(school_items_y))), NA_real_
    ),
    ngaugey01_rescored = case_when(
      ngaugey01 %in% 0:5 ~ as.numeric(ngaugey01),
      ngaugey01 %in% c(6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13) ~ match(ngaugey01, c(6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13)) - 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

validity_outcomes_y <- intersect(
  c("vqidsytot", "chrtytot", "chrtysttot", "chrtyprtot", "pscytot", "pscy_int",
    "pscy_att", "pscy_ext", "vasysxtot", "vasyiatot", "vasyhitot",
    "vasyperftot", "ngaugey01_rescored"),
  names(nqls_validity)
)

nqls_scores_y <- c("nqlsytot", "nqlsysubscalelife", "nqlsysubscaleschool")

correlation_results_y <- crossing(score = nqls_scores_y, outcome = validity_outcomes_y) %>%
  mutate(result = map2(score, outcome, ~ {
    keep <- complete.cases(nqls_validity[c(.x, .y)])
    test <- cor.test(nqls_validity[[.x]][keep], nqls_validity[[.y]][keep])
    tibble(
      n = sum(keep), r = unname(test$estimate),
      ci_low = test$conf.int[1], ci_high = test$conf.int[2], p = test$p.value
    )
  })) %>%
  unnest(result) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

correlation_results_y
```

```{r compare-validity-correlations}
compare_dependent_correlations <- function(data, outcome, score_1, score_2) {

  # Steiger's test requires all three correlations to come
  # from the same complete cases
  complete_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(
      all_of(c(outcome, score_1, score_2))
    ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))

  n <- nrow(complete_data)

  # Correlations with the common external measure
  r_1 <- cor(
    complete_data[[outcome]],
    complete_data[[score_1]],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  r_2 <- cor(
    complete_data[[outcome]],
    complete_data[[score_2]],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  # Correlation between the two NQLS scores
  r_12 <- cor(
    complete_data[[score_1]],
    complete_data[[score_2]],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  # Fisher's z-prime
  fisher_z_1 <- atanh(r_1)
  fisher_z_2 <- atanh(r_2)

  # Cohen's q
  cohens_q <- fisher_z_1 - fisher_z_2

  # Steiger test for dependent, overlapping correlations
  steiger_result <- cocor::cocor.dep.groups.overlap(
    r.jk = r_1,
    r.jh = r_2,
    r.kh = r_12,
    n = n,
    alternative = "two.sided",
    test = "steiger1980",
    var.labels = c(outcome, score_1, score_2)
  )

  tibble(
    outcome = outcome,
    score_1 = score_1,
    score_2 = score_2,
    n = n,
    r_1 = r_1,
    r_2 = r_2,
    delta_r = r_1 - r_2,
    r_between_scores = r_12,
    fisher_z_1 = fisher_z_1,
    fisher_z_2 = fisher_z_2,
    cohens_q = cohens_q,
    abs_q = abs(cohens_q),
    q_interpretation = case_when(
      abs_q < .10 ~ "Negligible",
      abs_q < .30 ~ "Small",
      abs_q < .50 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Large"
    ),
    steiger_z = unname(
      steiger_result@steiger1980$statistic
    ),
    p_value = steiger_result@steiger1980$p.value
  )
}
```

```{r}
contrasts <- tribble(
  ~score_1,            ~score_2,
  "nqlsytot",    "nqlsysubscalelife",
  "nqlsytot",    "nqlsysubscaleschool",
  "nqlsysubscalelife",  "nqlsysubscaleschool"
)

# PSC-17 subscales use the freshly-prorated pscy_int/pscy_att/pscy_ext (defined
# in the validity-data chunk above from raw items), not the precomputed
# pscyintot/pscyexttot/pscyatttot columns -- standardized to match the Table 4
# pipeline (validity_outcomes_y, above), which already used the fresh-recompute
# versions. Protocol Section 2 (v1.34) requires verifying any precomputed *tot
# column's coverage against its own raw items before trusting it; these
# precomputed subscale totals were never put through that check, so this
# removes an unverified dependency rather than relying on the two pipelines'
# numbers having happened to agree so far. N-Gauge is likewise standardized to
# the cleaned ngaugey01_rescored (built in the validity-data chunk) instead of
# the raw ngaugey01, which still carries uncleaned skip/response codes
# (6, 7, 10-13) that previously produced a materially different, wrong
# correlation here than in Table 4's pipeline.
outcomes <- c(
  "VQIDS Depression"                 = "vqidsytot",
  "CHRT Suicide Risk + AF"           = "chrtytot",
  "CHRT Propensity"                  = "chrtyprtot",
  "CHRT Suicidal Thoughts"           = "chrtysttot",
  "PSC-17 General MEB Problems"      = "pscytot",
  "PSC-17 Internalizing"             = "pscy_int",
  "PSC-17 Externalizing"             = "pscy_ext",
  "PSC-17 Attention"                 = "pscy_att",
  "VADRS ADHD"                       = "vasysxtot",
  "VADRS Hyperactivity/Impulsivity"  = "vasyhitot",
  "VADRS Inattention"                = "vasyiatot",
  "VADRS Performance"                = "vasyperftot",
  "N-Gauge Emotional Severity"       = "ngaugey01_rescored"
)
```

```{r}
correlation_comparisons <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  outcomes,
  function(outcome_variable, outcome_label) {

    purrr::pmap_dfr(
      contrasts,
      function(score_1, score_2) {

        compare_dependent_correlations(
          data = nqls_validity,
          outcome = outcome_variable,
          score_1 = score_1,
          score_2 = score_2
        ) %>%
          mutate(
            measure = outcome_label,
            contrast = paste(score_1, "vs.", score_2),
            .before = 1
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

correlation_comparisons <- correlation_comparisons %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = if_else(p_fdr < .05, "Yes", "No")
  )
```

```{r}
correlation_comparisons %>%
  select(
    measure,
    contrast,
    n,
    r_1,
    r_2,
    delta_r,
    fisher_z_1,
    fisher_z_2,
    cohens_q,
    q_interpretation,
    steiger_z,
    p_value,
    p_fdr,
    significant
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        r_1, r_2, delta_r,
        fisher_z_1, fisher_z_2,
        cohens_q, steiger_z
      ),
      ~ round(.x, 3)
    ),
    across(
      c(p_value, p_fdr),
      ~ round(.x, 4)
    )
  )
```
```{r}
results_table <- correlation_comparisons %>%
  transmute(
    Measure = measure,
    Comparison = contrast,
    n,
    r1 = r_1,
    r2 = r_2,
    Cohens_q = cohens_q,
    Steiger_z = steiger_z,
    p_FDR = p_fdr
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(r1, r2, Cohens_q, Steiger_z),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    ),
    p_FDR = case_when(
      p_FDR < .001 ~ "<.001",
      TRUE ~ sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p_FDR))
    )
  )
```

```{r efa}
poly_matrix_y <- psych::polychoric(nqlsGoodItems)$rho
```

```{r cfa}
model_1f_y <- '

  General =~ nqlsy01 + nqlsy02 + nqlsy05 + nqlsy06 + nqlsy07

model_bifactor_y <- '
  Total =~ nqlsy01 + nqlsy02 + nqlsy03 + nqlsy04 + nqlsy05 + nqlsy06 + nqlsy07
  General =~ nqlsy01 + nqlsy02 + nqlsy05 + nqlsy06 + nqlsy07
  School  =~ nqlsy03 + nqlsy04

fit_1f_y <- lavaan::cfa(
```

```{r}
get_ecv <- function(o) {
  if (!is.null(o$ECV)) return(round(as.numeric(o$ECV)[1], 2))
  sl <- tryCatch(o$schmid$sl, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(sl)) return(NA_real_)
  cn <- colnames(sl)
  gcol <- which(cn == "g")
  fcol <- grep("^F[0-9]+\\*?$", cn)
  if (length(gcol) != 1 || length(fcol) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  g2  <- sum(sl[, gcol]^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  tot <- g2 + sum(sl[, fcol]^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (tot == 0) NA_real_ else round(g2 / tot, 2)
}

univocality_indices <- function(df, items, nf) {
  X <- df[complete.cases(df[items]), items]
  ev_ratio <- tryCatch({
    invisible(capture.output(
      pa <- psych::fa.parallel(X, fa = "fa", cor = "poly", plot = FALSE)
    ))
    v <- pa$fa.values
    if (length(v) >= 2 && !any(is.na(v[1:2]))) round(v[1] / v[2], 1) else NA_real_
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  out <- c(EV1_EV2 = ev_ratio, omega_h = NA_real_, omega_tot = NA_real_, ECV = NA_real_)
  o <- tryCatch(psych::omega(X, nfactors = max(nf, 1L), poly = TRUE, plot = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(o)) {
    out["omega_tot"] <- round(as.numeric(o$omega.tot)[1], 2)
    if (nf >= 2) {
      out["omega_h"] <- round(as.numeric(o$omega_h)[1], 2)
      out["ECV"] <- get_ecv(o)
    }
  }
  out
}

h_coefficient <- function(lambda) {
  if (any(abs(lambda) >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    warning("h_coefficient(): at least one |loading| >= 1 (Heywood case) -- returning NA.")
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  1 / (1 + 1 / sum(lambda^2 / (1 - lambda^2)))
}

univocality_y <- univocality_indices(nqlsGoodItems, ord_items_y, nf = 2)

check_subscale_unidim <- function(items, label) {
  X <- nqlsGoodItems[items]
  poly <- psych::polychoric(X)$rho
  ev <- eigen(poly)$values
  om <- tryCatch(psych::omega(X, nfactors = 1, poly = TRUE, plot = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  al <- psych::alpha(X)
  data.frame(
    Subscale = label, n_items = length(items),
    EV1_EV2 = if (length(ev) >= 2) round(ev[1]/ev[2], 2) else NA,
    pct_var_F1 = round(100*ev[1]/sum(ev), 1),
    omega_total = if (!is.null(om)) round(as.numeric(om$omega.tot), 3) else NA,
    alpha = round(al$total$raw_alpha, 3),
    AIIC = round(mean(poly[upper.tri(poly)]), 3),
    r_drop_min = round(min(al$item.stats$r.drop), 3), r_drop_max = round(max(al$item.stats$r.drop), 3)
  )
}

full_unidim_y <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(nqls_full_y), function(nm)
  check_subscale_unidim(nqls_full_y[[nm]], nm)))

print(full_unidim_y, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r grm-functions}
exp_score_grm <- function(a, b, theta) {
  b <- b[is.finite(b)]
  if (!length(b)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(theta)))
  rowSums(vapply(b, function(bk) plogis(a * (theta - bk)), numeric(length(theta))))
}

extract_grm_parameters <- function(fit) {
  as.data.frame(mirt::coef(fit, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)$items) %>%
    rownames_to_column("item")
}

get_m2 <- function(fit) {
  out <- tryCatch(mirt::M2(fit, type = "C2"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out)) return(tibble(M2 = NA, df = NA, p = NA, RMSEA = NA, CFI = NA, TLI = NA, SRMSR = NA))
  tibble(M2 = out$M2, df = out$df, p = out$p, RMSEA = out$RMSEA,
         CFI = out$CFI, TLI = out$TLI, SRMSR = out$SRMSR)
}
```

```{r fit-grms-4}
## Reliability Plot Function
plot_reliability <- function(models, labels, colors = NULL,
                             theta_range = c(-4, 5),
                             threshold = 0.80,
                             title = "GRM: Conditional Reliability") {

  if (!is.list(models)) models <- list(models)
  if (length(models) != length(labels))
    stop("models and labels must be the same length")

  n_groups <- length(models)

  default_colors <- c("#2166AC", "#D6604D", "#4DAC26", "#7B2D8B")
  if (is.null(colors)) {
    colors <- setNames(default_colors[seq_len(n_groups)], labels)
  } else {
    colors <- setNames(colors, labels)
  }

  theta_seq <- seq(theta_range[1], theta_range[2], by = 0.01)

  rxx_list <- lapply(models, function(mod) {
    info <- testinfo(mod, Theta = matrix(theta_seq))
    info / (info + 1)
  })

  rxx_df <- data.frame(
    theta = rep(theta_seq, n_groups),
    rxx   = unlist(rxx_list),
    group = rep(labels, each = length(theta_seq))
  )
  rxx_df$group <- factor(rxx_df$group, levels = labels)

  find_crossings <- function(theta, rxx, threshold) {
    above     <- rxx >= threshold
    crossings <- which(diff(above) != 0)
    if (length(crossings) == 0) return(numeric(0))
    sapply(crossings, function(i) {
      approx(x = rxx[i:(i+1)], y = theta[i:(i+1)], xout = threshold)$y
    })
  }

  cross_list <- lapply(seq_len(n_groups), function(i) {
    cx <- find_crossings(theta_seq, rxx_list[[i]], threshold)
    if (length(cx) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(theta = cx, group = labels[i])
  })

  endpoints_df <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), cross_list))

  p <- ggplot(rxx_df, aes(x = theta, y = rxx, color = group)) +

    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = threshold, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +

    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = theta_range,
                       breaks = seq(theta_range[1], theta_range[2] - 1,
                                    by = 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.00), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25)) +

    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = expression(theta),
      y     = expression(r[xx]),
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position   = if (n_groups > 1) c(0.15, 0.88) else "none",
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )

  if (!is.null(endpoints_df) && nrow(endpoints_df) > 0) {
    endpoints_df$group <- factor(endpoints_df$group, levels = labels)
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(data        = endpoints_df,
                 aes(xintercept = theta, color = group),
                 linetype    = 5,
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
      ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
        data          = endpoints_df,
        aes(x = theta, y = 0, label = sprintf("%.2f", theta), color = group),
        label.size    = NA,
        nudge_y       = 0.1,
        box.padding   = 0.5,
        point.padding = 0.3,
        segment.color = NA,
        show.legend   = FALSE
      )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
## Info x Reliability Function
detect_itemtype <- function(data) {
  vapply(data, function(x) {
    n_levels <- length(unique(na.omit(x)))
    if (n_levels <= 2) "2PL" else "graded"
  }, character(1))
}

fit_grm_analysis <- function(data,
                              chart_title,
                              theta_range = seq(-4, 4, by = 0.05)) {

  itemtype <- detect_itemtype(data)
  message(sprintf("Fitting '%s' with itemtype: %s", chart_title,
                   paste(itemtype, collapse = ", ")))

  fit <- mirt(data, model = 1, itemtype = itemtype, SE = TRUE)
  print(fit)

  Theta      <- matrix(theta_range, ncol = 1)
  test_info  <- testinfo(fit, Theta)
  cond_rel   <- test_info / (test_info + 1)

  plot_df <- data.frame(theta = theta_range,
                         information = test_info,
                         reliability = cond_rel)

  invisible(list(fit = fit, itemtype = itemtype, plot_df = plot_df,
                 chart_title = chart_title))
}

## Find the theta values where the reliability curve crosses a given level
## (default .8), via linear interpolation between adjacent grid points.
find_reliability_crossings <- function(theta, reliability, level = 0.8) {
  crossings <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_len(length(theta) - 1)) {
    r1 <- reliability[i]; r2 <- reliability[i + 1]
    if (r1 == level) {
      crossings <- c(crossings, theta[i])
    } else if ((r1 - level) * (r2 - level) < 0) {
      t <- theta[i] + (level - r1) * (theta[i + 1] - theta[i]) / (r2 - r1)
      crossings <- c(crossings, t)
    }
  }
  if (reliability[length(reliability)] == level) {
    crossings <- c(crossings, theta[length(theta)])
  }
  sort(unique(crossings))
}
  
build_grm_plot <- function(grm_fit, rel_cut = 0.8) {

  chart_title <- grm_fit$chart_title
  plot_df     <- grm_fit$plot_df

  info_max     <- 25                                           # fixed for cross-informant comparison
  scale_factor <- info_max / 1.0                               # reliability max = 1
  plot_df$reliability_scaled <- plot_df$reliability * scale_factor

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = theta)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = information, color = "Information"), linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = reliability_scaled, color = "Reliability"), linewidth = 1.1) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Information",
      limits = c(0, info_max),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Reliability",
                           breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = expression("Theta ("*theta*")"),
                        breaks = seq(-4, 4, 1), limits = c(-4, 4)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL,
                        values = c("Information" = "#4C72B0",
                                   "Reliability" = "#0a7c0e")) +
    labs(title = chart_title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "#4C72B0"),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#0a7c0e"),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  ## Dashed reference lines marking the widest theta range over which
  ## reliability is at least `rel_cut` -- i.e. the two farthest-apart
  ## crossings of the reliability curve through rel_cut (curves that dip
  ## below and back above .8 more than once are collapsed to their
  ## outermost crossings).
  if (!is.null(rel_cut)) {
    crossings <- find_reliability_crossings(plot_df$theta, plot_df$reliability,
                                             level = rel_cut)
    if (length(crossings) >= 1) {
      x_left  <- min(crossings)
      x_right <- max(crossings)
      x_nudge  <- diff(range(plot_df$theta)) * 0.015
      label_df <- data.frame(theta = c(x_left, x_right),
                              label = sprintf("%.2f", c(x_left, x_right)),
                              hjust = c(1, 0))
      p <- p +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(x_left, x_right),
                   color = "#B05C6A", linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_text(data = label_df,
                  aes(x = theta + ifelse(hjust == 1, -x_nudge, x_nudge),
                      y = info_max * 0.97, label = label, hjust = hjust),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  color = "#B05C6A", size = 4, fontface = "bold",
                  vjust = 1)
    }
  }

  p
}

## Display a plot and save it to disk.
save_grm_plot <- function(p, output_file,
                           width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  print(p)
  ggsave(output_file, plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  cat("Chart saved to:", output_file, "\n")
  invisible(p)
}
```

# 8 Sex, age, and race DIF in the normative sample

```{r dif-preparation}
df$age_youth <- as.numeric(df[[age_source_y]])
df$age_strata_y <- case_when(
  df$age_youth >= 12 & df$age_youth <= 14 ~ 1L,
  df$age_youth >= 15 & df$age_youth <= 18 ~ 2L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# In the verified source, sex_select codes 1 and 2 identify the two adequately
# sized comparison groups. Other categories are retained in the data but omitted
# from this DIF analysis because of cell size.
sex_rows_y <- has_nqlsy_complete & df$sex_child %in% c(1, 2)
age_rows_y <- has_nqlsy_complete & !is.na(df$age_strata_y)

# Race DIF grouping: White vs. Non-White, from the child-race checkbox item
# race_child_m_1 ("Child's race - White"; 1 = selected, 2 = not selected).
# Any-endorsement split, stated explicitly: a multiracial respondent who
# checked White and another race is coded "White" here, consistent with how
# the checkbox item itself is structured (each race is its own yes/no item,
# not one mutually exclusive categorical field). This is a coarser grouping
# than the full race/ethnicity breakdown in Table 1 and collapses a diverse
# non-White group into one category -- a finer-grained analysis is a natural
# extension for a larger or differently-stratified sample.
df$race_white_vs_other <- case_when(
  df$race_child_m_1 == 1 ~ "White",
  df$race_child_m_1 == 2 ~ "Non-White",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
race_rows_y <- has_nqlsy_complete & !is.na(df$race_white_vs_other)

collapse_sparse <- function(dat, grp, min_n = 5) {
  dat <- as.data.frame(dat)
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(dat))) {
    repeat {
      x <- dat[[j]]
      levels_present <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
      x <- match(x, levels_present) - 1L
      dat[[j]] <- x
      k <- length(levels_present)
      if (k <= 2) break
      counts <- sapply(0:(k - 1), function(value) tapply(x == value, grp, sum, na.rm = TRUE))
      sparse <- which(apply(counts, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE) < min_n)
      if (!length(sparse)) break
      value <- (0:(k - 1))[sparse[1]]
      dat[[j]][dat[[j]] == value] <- if (value == k - 1) value - 1 else value + 1
    }
  }
  dat
}

run_lordif <- function(data, group) {
  lordif::lordif(
    resp.data = as.data.frame(data), group = group, criterion = "R2",
    R2.change = .02, alpha = .01, model = "GRM"
  )
}
```

```{r run-dif}
dif_results_y <- list()
for (scale_name in names(nqls_full_y)) {
  items <- nqls_full_y[[scale_name]]
  sex_data <- collapse_sparse(df[sex_rows_y, items], df$sex_child[sex_rows_y])
  age_data <- collapse_sparse(df[age_rows_y, items], df$age_strata_y[age_rows_y])
  race_data <- collapse_sparse(df[race_rows_y, items], df$race_white_vs_other[race_rows_y])

  # lordif needs at least three items; the two-item School subscale is skipped
  # for all three facets.
  sex_dif  <- if (length(items) >= 3) run_lordif(sex_data, df$sex_child[sex_rows_y]) else NULL
  age_dif  <- if (length(items) >= 3) run_lordif(age_data, df$age_strata_y[age_rows_y]) else NULL
  race_dif <- if (length(items) >= 3) run_lordif(race_data, df$race_white_vs_other[race_rows_y]) else NULL

  dif_results_y[[scale_name]] <- list(sex = sex_dif, age = age_dif, race = race_dif)
}
```

```{r normative-facet-invariance}
fit_facet_invariance <- function(data, items, group_name) {
  model <- paste0("F =~ ", paste(items, collapse = " + "))
  fits <- list(
    Configural = lavaan::cfa(
      model, data = data, group = group_name, ordered = items,
      estimator = "WLSMV", std.lv = TRUE
    ),
    Metric = lavaan::cfa(
      model, data = data, group = group_name, ordered = items,
      estimator = "WLSMV", std.lv = TRUE, group.equal = "loadings"
    ),
    Scalar = lavaan::cfa(
      model, data = data, group = group_name, ordered = items,
      estimator = "WLSMV", std.lv = TRUE,
      group.equal = c("loadings", "thresholds")
    )
  )
  imap_dfr(fits, ~ as_tibble_row(fit_values(.x)) %>%
             mutate(model = .y, .before = 1)) %>%
    mutate(delta_cfi = c(NA, diff(cfi)))
}

# General has enough indicators for informative facet-invariance models.
# School has only two indicators; its configural/metric models are saturated,
# so their global fit indices are not treated as evidence of invariance.
general_sex_data_y <- collapse_sparse(
  df[sex_rows_y, general_items_y], df$sex_child[sex_rows_y]
) %>% mutate(sex_select = factor(df$sex_child[sex_rows_y]))
```

# 10 Cross-sample measurement invariance

```{r cross-sample-models-1f}
# 1-factor
nqls1f_invariance_model <- '
  total =~ NQLS_Friends + NQLS_Family + NQLS_Grades + NQLS_School + NQLS_Health + NQLS_Life + NQLS_Future
'
fit_invariance1f <- function(equal = NULL, partial = NULL) {
  lavaan::cfa(
    nqls1f_invariance_model, data = invariance_data, group = "group",
    ordered = clinical_items, estimator = "WLSMV", parameterization = "theta",
    std.lv = TRUE, missing = "pairwise", group.equal = equal, group.partial = partial
  )
}

fit_1f_norm <- lavaan::cfa(
  nqls1f_invariance_model, data = filter(invariance_data, group == "NORM"),
  ordered = clinical_items, estimator = "WLSMV", parameterization = "theta",
  std.lv = TRUE, missing = "pairwise"
)
fit_1f_map <- lavaan::cfa(
  nqls1f_invariance_model, data = filter(invariance_data, group == "MAP"),
  ordered = clinical_items, estimator = "WLSMV", parameterization = "theta",
  std.lv = TRUE, missing = "pairwise"
)

fit_configural1 <- fit_invariance1f()
fit_metric1 <- fit_invariance1f("loadings")
fit_scalar1 <- fit_invariance1f(c("loadings", "thresholds"))
fit_partial_scalar1 <- fit_invariance1f(
  c("loadings", "thresholds"), thresholds_to_free
)
fit_partial_strict1 <- fit_invariance1f(
  c("loadings", "thresholds", "residuals"), thresholds_to_free
)

# Diagnose the scalar constraint and confirm the prespecified partial release.
scalar_score1 <- lavaan::lavTestScore(
  fit_scalar1, univariate = TRUE, epc = TRUE, standardized = TRUE
)
scalar_score1$uni
scalar_score1$epc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(op == "|") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(sepc.all)))
```

```{r observed-group-comparisons}
observed_group_results <- map_dfr(c("NQLS_Total_Sum", clinical_items), function(variable) {
  x <- invariance_data %>% select(group, all_of(variable)) %>% drop_na()
  test <- t.test(x[[variable]] ~ x$group)
  means <- x %>% group_by(group) %>% summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(.data[[variable]]),
                                               sd = sd(.data[[variable]]), .groups = "drop")
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((means$n[1] - 1) * means$sd[1]^2 + (means$n[2] - 1) * means$sd[2]^2) /
                    (sum(means$n) - 2))
  tibble(
    variable, n_NORM = means$n[means$group == "NORM"],
    mean_NORM = means$mean[means$group == "NORM"], sd_NORM = means$sd[means$group == "NORM"],
    n_MAP = means$n[means$group == "MAP"],
    mean_MAP = means$mean[means$group == "MAP"], sd_MAP = means$sd[means$group == "MAP"],
    difference_MAP_minus_NORM = mean_MAP - mean_NORM,
    cohen_d = difference_MAP_minus_NORM / pooled_sd,
    t = unname(test$statistic), df = unname(test$parameter), p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
observed_group_results
```

```{r score-method-comparison}
nqls_unit_weighted_y <- list(
  General = rowSums(nqlsGoodItems[general_items_y]),

nqls_eap_y <- imap(grm_fits_y, ~ as.numeric(mirt::fscores(.x, method = "EAP")[, 1]))
names(nqls_eap_y) <- c("Total", "General", "School")

score_correspondence_y <- tibble(
  scale = names(nqls_eap_y),
  r_unit_eap = map_dbl(names(nqls_eap_y), ~ stats::cor(
    nqls_unit_weighted_y[[.x]], nqls_eap_y[[.x]]
  ))
)
score_correspondence_y

omega_total_for_rci <- as.numeric(omega_total_y$omega.tot)
omega_general_for_rci <- as.numeric(omega_general_y$omega.tot)
omega_school_for_rci <- spearman_brown_school_y

rci_table_y <- imap_dfr(nqls_unit_weighted_y, function(score, scale_name) {
  reliability <- case_when(
    scale_name == "Total" ~ omega_total_for_rci,
    scale_name == "General" ~ omega_general_for_rci,
    scale_name == "School" ~ omega_school_for_rci,
    TRUE ~ alpha_diag_y$total$raw_alpha
  )
  sem <- sd(score) * sqrt(1 - reliability)
  se_diff <- sem * sqrt(2)
  tibble(
    scale = scale_name, mean = mean(score), sd = sd(score), reliability,
    SEM = sem, SEdiff = se_diff, RCI90 = 1.645 * se_diff,
    RCI95 = 1.96 * se_diff, MID_half_SD = .5 * sd(score),
    clinical_significance_M_minus_2SD = mean(score) - 2 * sd(score),
    empirical_P05 = unname(quantile(score, .05))
  )
})
rci_table_y
```

# 12 Optional retest analyses

```{r retest, eval=TRUE}
retest_items_y <- paste0(ord_items_y, "_recon")
retest_available_y <- all(retest_items_y %in% names(df)) &&
  "retest_same_child_strict.youth" %in% names(df)

if (retest_available_y) {
  retest_matched_y <- df %>%
    filter(
      has_nqlsy_complete,
      complete.cases(cur_data()[retest_items_y]),
      .data[["retest_same_child_strict.youth"]] == 1
    )

  retest_r_table_y <- imap_dfr(
    c(nqls_subscales_y, list(Total = ord_items_y)),
    function(items, scale_name) {
      time_1 <- rowSums(retest_matched_y[items])
      time_2 <- rowSums(retest_matched_y[paste0(items, "_recon")])
      test <- cor.test(time_1, time_2)
      tibble(
        scale = scale_name, n = length(time_1), r = unname(test$estimate),
        ci_low = test$conf.int[1], ci_high = test$conf.int[2],
        mean_time_1 = mean(time_1), mean_time_2 = mean(time_2)
      )
    }
  )
  retest_r_table_y
} else {
  message("Retest variables are unavailable; Section 12 was skipped.")
}
```

# 13 Optional parent-youth agreement

```{r cross-informant}
parent_items_y <- paste0("nqlsp0", 1:7)
parent_items_available_y <- all(parent_items_y %in% names(df))

if (parent_items_available_y) {
  dyads_y <- df %>%
    filter(complete.cases(cur_data()[c(ord_items_y, parent_items_y)])) %>%
    mutate(
      youth_total = rowSums(across(all_of(ord_items_y))),
      parent_total = rowSums(across(all_of(parent_items_y))),
      dyad_mean = (youth_total + parent_total) / 2,
      youth_minus_parent = youth_total - parent_total
    )

  cross_informant_summary_y <- tibble(
    n = nrow(dyads_y),
    r = cor(dyads_y$youth_total, dyads_y$parent_total),
    mean_difference = mean(dyads_y$youth_minus_parent),
    sd_difference = sd(dyads_y$youth_minus_parent),
    loa_low = mean_difference - 1.96 * sd_difference,
    loa_high = mean_difference + 1.96 * sd_difference
  )
  cross_informant_summary_y

  summary(lm(youth_total ~ parent_total, data = dyads_y))
  t.test(dyads_y$youth_total, dyads_y$parent_total, paired = TRUE)
  psych::ICC(dyads_y[c("youth_total", "parent_total")])

  item_agreement_y <- map2_dfr(ord_items_y, parent_items_y, function(youth_item, parent_item) {
    tibble(
      item = youth_item,
      exact_agreement = mean(dyads_y[[youth_item]] == dyads_y[[parent_item]]),
      polychoric_r = psych::polychoric(
        dyads_y[c(youth_item, parent_item)], correct = 0
      )$rho[1, 2]
    )
  })
  item_agreement_y

  ggplot(dyads_y, aes(dyad_mean, youth_minus_parent)) +
    geom_point(alpha = .25) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = cross_informant_summary_y$mean_difference) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(cross_informant_summary_y$loa_low,
                             cross_informant_summary_y$loa_high), linetype = 2) +
    labs(x = "Mean of parent and youth totals", y = "Youth minus parent total") +
    theme_minimal()
} else {
  message("Parent NQLS items are unavailable; cross-informant analysis was skipped.")
}
```

# 14 Age-referenced norms

```{r norming-data}
# CLEANUP NOTE: this chunk previously fit an 8-candidate-family GAMLSS
# comparison (ZINBI, ZANBI, ZAGA, NBI, PO, BCCG, BI, BB) across all three NQLS
# scores (General, School, Total) via candidate_norm_fits_y/fit_gamlss(), with
# a selected_family_y vector declaring the chosen family per score
# (Total = "BB"). That block was never referenced again anywhere in this
# document -- it fed no downstream table, figure, or model -- and its own
# declaration for Total ("BB") did not match the family actually used for the
# reported Total norms below (BCCG, chosen via the separate, Total-specific
# candidate comparison in the next chunks: nqls_no/nqls_bccg/nqls_bcpe/
# nqls_bb, compared by GAIC). Removed rather than left in place with a
# declared choice that contradicted what the manuscript's reported final model
# actually used. The General and School subscales do not yet have a
# finalized, reported norming model in this document; building one should
# follow the same GAIC/worm-plot/Q-statistic workflow used for Total below,
# with its own explicit family declaration kept in sync with whatever model
# actually gets used -- not reintroduce an unused, silently-stale comparison.
```

```{r}
coverage <- function(model, fam, data, y, bd = NULL,
                     cent = c(50, 75, 90, 95)) {
  p    <- predictAll(model, data = data)
  qfun <- get(paste0("q", fam))
  sapply(cent, function(cc) {
    args <- list(p = cc / 100, mu = p$mu)
    if (!is.null(p$sigma)) args$sigma <- p$sigma
    if (!is.null(p$nu))    args$nu    <- p$nu
    if (!is.null(p$tau))   args$tau   <- p$tau
    if (!is.null(bd))      args$bd    <- bd
    mean(y <= do.call(qfun, args))
  }) |> setNames(paste0("c", cent))
}

nqls <- df %>% 
  select(actual_age, sex_child, nqlsytot) %>% 
  mutate(
    femaleyn = case_when(
      sex_child == 2 ~ 1,
      sex_child == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    femaleyn = factor(femaleyn),
    nqlsytot_count = round(nqlsytot),
    nqlsytot_nonzero = nqlsytot + 0.0001
  )

nqls <- na.omit(nqls)

describe(nqls$nqlsytot)
```

```{r}
cent <- c(5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95)

nqls_grid <- expand.grid(
  actual_age = seq(12, 18, length.out = 1000),
  femaleyn = unique(nqls$femaleyn)
)

nqls_pred <- nqls_grid

## Final selection - BCCG

nqls_pred$mu <- predict(nqls_bccg, newdata = nqls_grid,  what = "mu", type = "response")
nqls_pred$sigma <- predict(nqls_bccg, newdata = nqls_grid, what = "sigma", type = "response")
nqls_pred$nu <- predict(nqls_bccg, newdata = nqls_grid, what = "nu", type = "response")

nqls_cent <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cent, function(p){
  val <- qBCCG(p/100, mu = nqls_pred$mu, sigma = nqls_pred$sigma, nu = nqls_pred$nu)
  data.frame(age = nqls_pred$actual_age, femaleyn = nqls_pred$femaleyn, percentile = p, value = val)
}))
```

```{r}
cent_level <- c(95, 90, 75, 50, 25, 10, 5)
nqls_cent$value <- nqls_cent$value - 0.0001
nqls_cent$percentile <- factor(nqls_cent$percentile, levels = cent_level)
```

```{r}
nqls_fullyear_grid <- expand.grid(
  actual_age = 12:18,
  femaleyn = unique(nqls$femaleyn)
) 

nqls_fullyear_pred <- nqls_fullyear_grid

nqls_fullyear_pred$mu <- predict(nqls_bccg, newdata = nqls_fullyear_grid,  what = "mu", type = "response")
nqls_fullyear_pred$sigma <- predict(nqls_bccg, newdata = nqls_fullyear_grid, what = "sigma", type = "response")
nqls_fullyear_pred$nu <- predict(nqls_bccg, newdata = nqls_fullyear_grid, what = "nu", type = "response")

nqls_fullyear_cent <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cent, function(p){
  val <- qBCCG(p/100, mu = nqls_fullyear_pred$mu, sigma = nqls_fullyear_pred$sigma, nu = nqls_fullyear_pred$nu)
  data.frame(age = nqls_fullyear_pred$actual_age, femaleyn = nqls_fullyear_pred$femaleyn, centile = p, value = val)
}))

nqls_fullyear_cent$value <- nqls_fullyear_cent$value - 0.0001
nqls_fullyear_cent$value <- pmin(pmax(nqls_fullyear_cent$value, 0), 28)
```

```{r}
nqls_table_male <- nqls_fullyear_cent %>% 
  filter(femaleyn == 0) %>% 
  select(age, centile, value) %>% 
  mutate(
    value = round(value)
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = centile,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  arrange(age)

nqls_table_female <- nqls_fullyear_cent %>% 
  filter(femaleyn == 1) %>% 
  select(age, centile, value) %>% 
  mutate(
    value = round(value)
  ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = centile,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  arrange(age)
```

# 15 Save analysis tables

```{r save-tables}
dir.create("nqls_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

tables_to_save <- list(
  descriptive_items = psych::describe(nqlsGoodItems),
  validity_correlations = correlation_results_y,
  validity_comparisons = results_table,
  efa_retention = retention_summary_y,
  cfa_comparison = cfa_comparison_y,
  reliability = reliability_table_y,
  grm_fit = grm_fit_table_y,
  grm_parameters = grm_parameter_table_y,
  cross_sample_invariance = invariance_table,
  latent_means_tot = latent_mean_results_tot,
  latent_means_sub = latent_mean_results_sub,
  observed_group_comparisons = observed_group_results,
  change_benchmarks = rci_table_y,
  norms_female = nqls_table_female,
  norms_male = nqls_table_male
)

iwalk(tables_to_save, ~ readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(.x),
                                         file.path("nqls_outputs", paste0(.y, ".csv"))))

iwalk(norm_tables_y, ~ readr::write_csv(.x,
                                        file.path("nqls_outputs", paste0("norms_", tolower(.y), ".csv"))))
```
